brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for parents who want practical reassurance before buying. We have no approved reviews or certifications to quote. Use available product information and support without implying the home becomes child-safe.

variants.primary_text: Little ones exploring around a table? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes edge and corner protectors to help cover furniture corners as part of your childproofing routine. It’s one practical detail to address around everyday furniture, while adult supervision remains important. Explore the kit for your home.
variants.headline: Edge and corner protectors for home childproofing

variants.primary_text: Thinking about the cabinets and fridge doors little hands may reach? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes cabinet and fridge locks, giving you a way to address those access points in your childproofing plan. Use them as one part of the routine, alongside adult supervision. See the kit details.
variants.headline: Locks for cabinets and the fridge

variants.primary_text: Unsure where to begin with childproofing pieces around the home? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes 1-to-1 installation video support, so you can get guidance as you work through setup. It’s there if you want help with the kit; adult supervision remains important. Explore the kit and its support.
variants.headline: Get 1-to-1 installation video support

internal_notes: The everyday scenes are hypothetical and do not imply observed customer behaviour or specific product fit.
